desc: Reformulate stamina conditions using prefix potentials and express each person as endpoint equality plus strict inequalities on the interior.
Derive a necessary-and-sufficient structural contradiction criterion for a set of interval constraints, including interactions among nested, crossing, and oppositely directed journeys.
Derive an efficient offline computation of the maximal feasible right endpoint for every left endpoint, rather than rebuilding a graph per query.
Design a data structure answering each \([L,R]\) query in \(O(\log M)\) after preprocessing.
Prove correctness and verify edge cases such as reversed journeys, overlapping intervals, and constraints sharing endpoints.
Ensure the final Python implementation meets \(N\le4\cdot10^5\), \(M,Q\le2\cdot10^5\) time and memory limits.
